caption: The drawing depicts a detailed illustration of a bellows at the center, composed mainly of brown and tan hues with intricate floral designs in shades of yellow, gold, and rust red on its largest surface area. The bellows has a wooden handle at the top, with a metal tip at the bottom that is colored in shades of green and gold, and is decorated with rivets or studs. The area connecting the metal tip to the body has a red-brown section that is visually distinct from the rest of the body. Two additional sketches are present in the drawing: one at the lower left, showing a simplified outline and side detail of the bellows in a light gray or pencil tone, and another at the upper right, featuring the design of a clasp or hanging mechanism in a similarly minimalistic style. The background is a light tan or beige, and the composition centers the decorated bellows with the two smaller sketches placed diagonally on either side.
title: Bellows
